name: e-National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
eligibility_facts: farmer registration requires selected APMC and KYC; FPO/FPCs can register
hard_exclusions: not a generic cash subsidy for farmers
questions: Do you want help selling your farm produce or finding better market prices?
What produce do you want to sell?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: farmer registration requires selected APMC and KYC; FPO/FPCs can register

question.en: Can you register through a selected APMC and complete the required KYC, either as a farmer or an eligible FPO/FPC?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଚୟନିତ APMC ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ କରି ଆବଶ୍ୟକ KYC ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରିପାରିବେ କି, ଚାଷୀ କିମ୍ବା ଯୋଗ୍ୟ FPO/FPC ଭାବେ?

description.en: Participation by the relevant state and market must be confirmed separately.
description.or: ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ରାଜ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ବଜାରର ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] not a generic cash subsidy for farmers

description.en: e-NAM is a market-access platform, not a general cash-subsidy scheme.
description.or: e-NAM ଏକ ବଜାର ପ୍ରବେଶ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମ; ଏହା ସାଧାରଣ ନଗଦ ସବସିଡି ଯୋଜନା ନୁହେଁ।
